item.title: Washington Wizards get a good piece in Anthony Davis
item.description: Numbers on the Board takes a look at the trade that brought Anthony Davis to Washington D.C. and what he brings to the Wizards.

item.title: Is Kristaps Porzingis a piece for the Warriors or an expiring contract?
item.description: Numbers on the Board analyze the deal that sent Porzingis to the Warriors and why Golden State fans may want to hold their enthusiasm for their new big man.

item.title: Can James Harden get over the hump with the Cavaliers?
item.description: Numbers on the Board discuss the Clippers moving James Harden to Cleveland and whether the 11-time All-Star can help the Cavaliers turn things around in the postseason.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo staying with Bucks feels like wasted time
item.description: Numbers on the Board talk about the Milwaukee Bucks keeping Giannis Antetokounmpo past the trade deadline and how that domino not falling still created ripples across the league.
